manual_notes: The original four views gate on saved container source/id and mount a shared warning below the header. The component fetches the route-specific list, stores only the selected container, hides for loading/missing/running/error cases and links to the container with translated copy. A subsequent change deliberately moves banners into Properties; that supersession does not erase this historical delivery.
